usage: This is a casual and very common way to say "see you later" when parting with friends, colleagues, or acquaintances in Cairo. It implies you expect to see the person again relatively soon, though not necessarily on the exact same day. For a slightly warmer or more polite farewell, Egyptians often use "ashoufak 3ala kheir" (see you on good terms).

variants.label: to a man
variants.note: The standard casual farewell addressed to a single male.

variants.label: to a woman
variants.note: The standard casual farewell addressed to a single female.

variants.label: to a group
variants.note: Used when addressing two or more people.

variants.label: warmer alternative
variants.note: A slightly more affectionate or polite way to say goodbye, wishing them well until next time.

examples.english: I have to go now, see you later.
See you later, call me when you arrive. (to a woman)
